title: A Primer of the Spanning Stirrup
summary: Teaches a beginner to span and seat a light foot-stirrup crossbow safely and to loose one bolt using body strength alone.

title: Handbook of Plain Crossbow Aim
summary: Teaches body-only sighting along the stock and the steady trigger squeeze used against stationary targets.

title: Workbook of the Hand-Span Prod
summary: Builds the wrist and forearm strength to span a light prod by hand and the hold that keeps it spanned.

title: The Short Course in Bolt Handling
summary: Teaches choosing and carrying and checking and laying bolts so every shot begins with a straight secure bolt.

title: Drill-Book for the Tiller Stock
summary: Drills the stance and grip and shoulder seat that hold the tiller steady through span and aim and release.

title: A Walking Guide to Safe Cocking
summary: Explains the habits that keep a spanned crossbow from firing by accident while the carrier walks and climbs and rests.

title: Treatise on the Steady Quarrel
summary: Introduces a first thread of qi into the hold and release so a new Senior keeps a quarrel flying straight.

title: Canon of the Crouch and Loose
summary: Teaches loosing from crouch and kneel and prone holds while using qi lightly to stay balanced and quiet.

title: Primer on Drop and Lead
summary: Shows how to judge a bolt's fall and the lead on a walking mark and to hold the correction with light qi.

title: Lessons in the Light Crossbow Round
summary: A round of timed drills in which a Senior spans and loads and looses a light crossbow while keeping qi use small.

title: Notes on Carrying the Spanned Bow
summary: Gives a Senior ways to march and wait and take cover with a spanned crossbow while qi eases the load.

title: A Reader of Quarrel and Quiver
summary: A reader of reload habits that teaches a Senior to keep quiver and bolt and hand in one steady rhythm.
